hierarchy.caption: text-[10px] sm:text-xs text-slate-400 font-mono tracking-wider uppercase

pitch.name: Pitch

shoreline.name: Shoreline
shoreline.desc: Tidal beach (+15% Water move damage, Electric resistance)

spacing_and_layout.container_padding: p-3 sm:p-4 max-w-md md:max-w-2xl lg:max-w-4xl mx-auto pb-32

progressive_loading_bar.container_style: w-full bg-slate-900/90 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-3 shadow-lg backdrop-blur-md mb-3

progressive_loading_bar.label: text-xs font-mono text-cyan-400 flex justify-between items-center mb-1.5

roster_card.unlocked_style: relative flex flex-col items-center justify-between p-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-900/80 border border-slate-800 hover:border-blue-500/50 hover:bg-slate-800/90 transition-all cursor-pointer active:scale-95 shadow-sm group min-h-[110px]
roster_card.locked_silhouette_style: relative flex flex-col items-center justify-between p-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-950/90 border border-slate-900 opacity-70 cursor-not-allowed min-h-[110px]

bottom_selected_tray.fixed_shell: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 z-40 bg-slate-950/95 border-t border-slate-800 backdrop-blur-xl px-3 py-2 shadow-2xl
bottom_selected_tray.slots_grid: flex items-center justify-between gap-1.5 max-w-md md:max-w-2xl mx-auto
bottom_selected_tray.slot_box: w-12 h-12 sm:w-14 sm:h-14 rounded-lg bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-center relative transition-all overflow-hidden

detail_popover.modal_overlay: fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/70 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-end sm:items-center justify-center p-0 sm:p-4
detail_popover.content_sheet: w-full sm:max-w-lg bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-t-2xl sm:rounded-2xl p-4 sm:p-6 shadow-2xl max-h-[85vh] overflow-y-auto

battle_hud.top_bar: w-full bg-slate-950/90 border-b border-slate-800 p-2 sm:p-3 flex items-center justify-between backdrop-blur-md
battle_hud.hp_bar: h-3 bg-slate-800 rounded-full overflow-hidden border border-slate-700/60
battle_hud.canvas_container: relative w-full aspect-[4/3] sm:aspect-[16/9] bg-slate-950 rounded-xl overflow-hidden border border-slate-800 shadow-inner

gauntlet_strip.wrapper: flex items-center justify-between gap-1.5 p-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-900/90 border border-slate-800 overflow-x-auto
gauntlet_strip.node: flex flex-col items-center justify-center min-w-[48px] p-2 rounded-lg border text-xs font-mono font-bold

motion_and_animations.tick_rate: 60Hz Canvas game loop for real-time 1v1 auto-combat

instructions_to_main_agent: Use raw HTML/Tailwind CSS with Lucide icons for UI components, optimized for mobile responsiveness.
Harmonize all 18 Pokémon type badges using the specific background, text, and border colors defined in colors.pokemon_types_harmonized.
Render locked creatures with silhouette styling using filter: brightness(0) invert(0.2) and show lock icons.
Implement progressive loading state: as species data/sprites load from IndexedDB/PokeAPI, update the loading bar percentage dynamically.
Persist PokeAPI creature list and sprite cache in IndexedDB and game progression (unlocked count, wins, gauntlet rank, custom teams) in localStorage.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes matching testing_attributes specs.
